body: I don't think `APP_RUN_STAGE_SETUP` is needed, as you could move this block of code to the delegate method  [`applicationWillFinishLaunching:`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit/nsapplicationdelegate/applicationwillfinishlaunching(_:)?language=objc)

When setting this, you can call `[NSApp terminate: nil]` to trigger the standard termination logic.

I notice in your updated implementation of the `applicationShouldTerminate:` delegate method, you check this and return `NSTerminateNow` which is 👍🏻

With the other changes, you can then move this logic to the [`applicationWillTerminate:`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit/nsapplicationdelegate/applicationwillterminate(_:)?language=objc) delegate method, which runs during termination. You won't need to call the other `[NSApp ..]` methods here, as it is already shutting down.
Wont work. Terminate will never return to the main and set exit code, so it will break a lot of stuff depending on exit code.
Since `terminate` is not used, this won't always be called.
